Name: Radioactive Coffee for CP
Author: Falax073
Description:
This mod adds Radioactive Coffee Beans and Coffee/Triple Shot Espresso made from them. Because I'm to stupid to figure out how to make a recipe require fuel in CP you can now buy the Radioactive Coffee Bean from Krobus for 100.000 G (Quite expensive, but remember the coffee ist about 5 times better the the normal one) Plant them in spring or summer, wait 10 days and harvest your fresh radioactive coffee beans. Put them in a keg to produce radioactive coffee. The recipe for radioactive triple shot espresso can be bought from Krobus too, even if it's quite expensive.(1.000.000 G)
Please give me feedback, it's my first time modding

Manifest.Name: Radioactive Coffee Mod
Manifest.Description: Adds radioactive coffee items and recipes using Content Patcher.
